description: Aggregate the European funding picture for a period in ONE call: totals (disclosed €, split into equity / debt / grant €, rounds, companies, investors, exits), concentration, and breakdowns by country, sector and stage — with provenance (disclosed %, high-confidence %, ECB reconciliation Δ). Beats paging every round to sum client-side. Defaults to the current year.

period.description: A year ("2026"), half-year ("2026-h1"), quarter ("2026-q1") or month ("2026-01"); defaults to the current year

name: market_map
